query: Implement Scope 3 supplier carbon emissions extraction and reporting pipeline for a global manufacturing enterprise with 2,400 tier-1 suppliers across 14 countries
constraints: Must comply with EU CSRD (Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive) effective 2025
Must integrate with SAP S/4HANA procurement module via standard BAPI interfaces
Must support ISO 14064-1 and GHG Protocol Scope 3 Category 1 methodology
Data residency requirements: EU supplier data must remain in EU-West region
Must handle supplier data in 8 languages with UTF-8 normalization
Maximum 72-hour data freshness SLA for tier-1 supplier emissions factors
Budget ceiling: $2.4M over 18 months including infrastructure and staffing
success_criteria: Automated extraction covers >= 85% of tier-1 suppliers within 6 months
Emissions calculation variance < 5% compared to manual audit baseline
End-to-end pipeline latency < 4 hours for full supplier portfolio refresh
Zero critical data quality incidents in production for 90 consecutive days
Regulatory submission artifacts generated within 48 hours of quarter close
System achieves SOC 2 Type II attestation within 12 months

phases.name: Optimization
phases.focus: ML-assisted gap filling, anomaly detection, scale
